methods.label: Interpret the negative exponents as reciprocals
methods.explanation:
For any nonzero number \(x\), \(x^{-1}=1/x\). First calculate the expression inside the parentheses:
\[
4^{-1}-3^{-1}
=\frac14-\frac13
=\frac3{12}-\frac4{12}
=-\frac1{12}.
\]
This value is nonzero, so the outer exponent \(-1\) takes its reciprocal:
\[
\left(-\frac1{12}\right)^{-1}=-12.
\]
The answer is \(-12\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
